games.title: Origami Rush
games.description: Origami Rush — a origami paper lane-switch dodge & collect game. Swipe or use arrows to switch lanes. Grab the orbs, dodge the spikes.

games.title: Moonlit Bounce
games.description: Moonlit Bounce — a moonlit rooftops endless brick-breaker game. Bounce the ball to shatter every brick. Clear a wave and a denser one drops. Miss the ball and it's over.

games.title: Coral Reaction
games.description: Coral Reaction — a coral reef color-target tap test game. Tap the glowing rings before they fade. Never tap a crossed one, and don't let too many good ones slip away.

games.title: Crystal Leap
games.tagline: Easy to learn. Hard to master.
games.description: Crystal Leap — a crystal cavern tap-to-flap through gaps game. Tap (or Space) to flap and thread every gap. Touch a wall or the floor and you're done.

games.title: Vaporwave Heights
games.tagline: Easy to learn. Hard to master.
games.description: Vaporwave Heights — a vaporwave sunset precision block stacking game. Tap to drop each block on the one below. Overhang gets sliced off — miss completely and the tower falls.

games.title: Galaxy Pulse
games.description: Galaxy Pulse — a galaxy nebula omni-directional dodge & collect game. Glide to dodge the incoming shards and scoop the glowing motes. One hit and it's over.

games.title: Voidfall
games.description: Slide through a storm of neon shards, scoop glowing orbs, and survive as the void speeds up.
